summary: Ligand Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to report the closing of a $700M zero-coupon convertible senior notes offering due 2031, including the full exercise of the initial purchasers' option. The notes are unsecured, mature September 15, 2031, and are convertible under certain conditions tied to stock price thresholds or redemption events. The company will pay cash up to the principal amount and stock for any excess conversion value. This is a routine capital-raising transaction and does not constitute a special situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or shareholder vote is involved; the filing is a standard debt issuance disclosure.
